needs.premise: One invocation/escrow/ticket and one abstract callback frame; captured-result, native-only isolation or suspended-callback cuts are assumed qualification; other whole-round gates, exact root descriptors and native effects remain premises
22 conditional declarations: credit Step/Trace, coverage/custody rejection, business-completion independence and decreasing declared wait rank; no all-action QNT/C simulation or native fairness

Separate business completion debt from uncovered GC debt: wrapper allocation can itself call GC; captured native result plus frozen complete roots may close GC without returning the constructor. No direct refinement claim to prior total-constructor-zero law; mapping and source pause cuts must be proved

Before native production reserve backed no-GC ticket/root/result slots, exact native leases and code; publish frozen construction view before conversion allocation may GC; retain physical owner across failure, payload capture and wrapper/result root publication

Accept rollback targets created client not borrowed server; process return-slot failure retains dev/pid/pipe/status and temporary-string duties with original error mapping; Win32 removed message retains MSG/RC and external message ownership; no false replay/rollback of external effects

Only known root/custody/authority metadata with native-only bounded effects permits outcome-isolated resume; unknown root writers/profile/slot owner refuses seal. Accepted query is not reexecution, native disposition proof or ticket refund; process side effects and MSG pointer payloads need exact independent profiles

Seal captures current epoch/generation, blocks managed writers, scans all ancestor/callback/root views; active-permit reentry consumes the frozen view and restores managed writer authority before allocation/callback/result delivery; late native-only result stores cannot add managed roots

Owner may wait GC; GC may wait bounded root-view scanning; scanning/cleanup may not acquire owner port mutex, callback permit, PSTATE wait scratch or new collector allocation capacity. Declared rank is valid only if all transitive service/lock edges are covered; no arbitrary native-call timeout guarantee

Release/acquire escrow view and result publication; gate close/reservation capture; borrowed native device/RC chain lifetime; generation-safe result/reader/ticket retirement and no-escape initialization require actual C/platform proof

Atomically reserve slot/root/code/wait/handle/native-byte capacity before native production; every wrapped, in-flight, queued and terminal-retained right occupies one disjoint ticket; finite descendant bounds or same-ticket resumable continuation required; no refund from ACK/unknown result

Declare dependency shape at profile registration; root and pin concrete dependencies before first GC/native escape; trace/relocate current-round roots before cleanup settlement, or counted pre-seal rescan under admitted credit; FOREIGN opacity, RC teardown and profile/code readers require real closure

Bind exact release code/library/config generation, transitive callbacks/locks/allocator/free effects, owner/VM/processor/thread affinity and typed disposal to each producing right; unknown effects/affinity or invalid rollback target refuses deferred admission

Explicit foreign-release!, value-conversion rollback and library/device constructor rollback retain synchronous outcome/visibility unless separately proven equivalent; GC deferral needs legal delay, teardown needs service drain; no-op/permanent wrappers create zero release jobs

C release/acquire publish immutable profile and accepted ticket before source detach; close producer gate then acquire all reservations; generation-safe root/slot/code retirement after readers/children; stop/unknown foreign effects remain platform obligations

Every admitted strong/weak/private/cleanup duty closes or has qualified deferred handoff; capacity success or safe-error outcome, context preparation, result delivery, binding, writer closure and current generation precede active permit; domain-wide finalizer inventory required

Only qualified native-only execution may overlap GC; owner/managed callback waits until active permit and rooted activation, while cleanup never waits for that callback; explicit WaitContext replaces PSTATE scratch

Reserve before destructive wrapper retirement; canonical task owns payload/dependencies/credits and accepted decision before source drops custody; queue notification or transport loss is not acceptance/completion

Unknown handoff/root/writer/capacity/binding/gate states refuse resume; isolated native result unknown may retain resources while GC resumes; typed effect/disposition forbids replay or refund inferred from scalar error

closureCosts.removedWork: Remove dependency GC -> constructor return when the return itself needs GC
closureCosts.bound: For F frozen pending invocations, GC does not wait for F business completions; GC-critical uncovered debt must be zero
closureCosts.addedCost: F stable escrow records, no-GC publication and root scanning
closureCosts.condition: No claim all native producers can freeze; absent profile/stop/root evidence still refuses

closureCosts.removedWork: Scan roots independently of owner port mutex/callback permit
closureCosts.bound: Declared wait rank owner=2 > GC=1 > bounded scan service=0
closureCosts.addedCost: Pre-backed scan metadata, pinned handles and transitive lock audit
closureCosts.condition: No deadlock proof beyond declared wait graph; all hidden callbacks/locks need source refinement

closureCosts.removedWork: Query canonical result instead of re-accept/re-fork/re-read
closureCosts.bound: At most 1 native producer invocation and 1 wrapper/result delivery per modeled attempt
closureCosts.addedCost: Attempt identity, result/root slot and outcome-retention metadata
closureCosts.condition: This saves duplicate work only relative to an incorrect replay strategy, not a claimed speedup over current C

closureCosts.removedWork: Keep admitted constructor completion/rollback wait off root closure
closureCosts.bound: Delta critical work = eliminated reverse-wait dependency minus freeze/scan/ledger costs; no finite wait-time bound on external calls
closureCosts.addedCost: Capture/freeze/scan/reentry actions and result root publication
closureCosts.condition: Positive only when service never waits on owner and added work is cheaper; not a wall-time measurement

closureCosts.removedWork: Transfer existing persistent credit from source -> escrow -> wrapper or terminal
closureCosts.bound: Live duties <= pre-reserved slots; one duty remains charged while business result or disposal unknown
closureCosts.addedCost: Canonical record/receipt generation and reader/child drain
closureCosts.condition: No additional ticket for ordinary continuation of same duty; fanout needs separate reservation

closureCosts.removedWork: Share immutable profile; keep per-attempt escrow and frozen view
closureCosts.addedCost: Physical resident backing exists before native effect
closureCosts.condition: Logical quota alone cannot guarantee no allocation failure; layouts/sizes remain unmeasured

closureCosts.removedWork: Avoid requiring both old and copied payloads when exact ownership transfers
closureCosts.addedCost: Captured client/process/MSG may outlive the GC; unknown outcome retains it
closureCosts.condition: Count shared native backing once; no whole-round peak reduction proved

closureCosts.removedWork: Bound process-local memory/handles without claiming external process/network memory
closureCosts.bound: Native bytes/handles charged by exact staged recipe; child process heap and OS/global resources have separate bounds
closureCosts.addedCost: Per-provider bound, temporary strings/pipes/TLS/RC overhead and side-effect state
closureCosts.condition: Unknown bounds refuse bounded admission; kernel/external resources are not covered by Scheme heap quota

closureCosts.removedWork: Unify custody support while preserving three different source semantics
closureCosts.bound: 3 failure cuts: accepted client vs server; process result/error+dev duty; consumed MSG/RC duty
closureCosts.addedCost: Source correction, per-stage disposal and exception/error mapping
closureCosts.condition: No existing path retired; fixnum/device/#f behavior needs independent semantic acceptance

closureCosts.removedWork: Allow GC closure when only bounded native outcome is unknown
closureCosts.bound: 0 extra invocation and 0 physical refund from timeout/notification loss; query then known-result reentry
closureCosts.addedCost: Potentially indefinite quarantine and retained roots/code/resource budget
closureCosts.condition: Unknown managed writer, dependency shape, callback frame or owner transfer is not isolatable

closureCosts.removedWork: Scheme-generated contracts and shared modern C service support
closureCosts.bound: No incremental Zig runtime-work saving established
closureCosts.addedCost: Both need escrow/root/lock/ABI/effect and memory-order proofs
closureCosts.condition: Modern C mandatory; a language switch supplies neither GC coverage nor deadlock freedom

nodes.labelText: Pre-backed ticket + dependency/result slots\nScheme/native inputs remain rooted
Native producer / exact staged resource duty\naccept, process creation, message consume
Captured native result escrow\nwrapper conversion may invoke GC
Suspended callback / ancestor frames\nonly a fully covered stop cut qualifies
Native-only bounded outcome unknown\nno managed access / callback / hidden roots
Close managed publication authority\nfreeze epoch + root/custody view
Independent bounded root scan\nnever acquire owner port mutex
Whole-round gates + covered debt zero\nbusiness completion may remain pending
Consume seal and reacquire runtime\nrestore roots / writer permission
Exact result-slot query or one conversion\nroot result before delivery / rollback
Unknown GC-critical metadata\nretain custody; refuse this resume
Known disposal + readers/children drain\nphysical backing release then ticket recycle
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C-memory gates open

callers.actualChain: alloc_scmobj_still can release allocation lock then call GC before allocating/linking still wrapper
callers.hazard: Constructor return can depend on the GC it invoked; object body initialization belongs to caller before next allocation
callers.replacement: Frozen escrow root view and ticket before entry; no collector wait for business completion

callers.actualChain: Allocate FOREIGN then write tags/release_fn/ptr and result slot; allocation may have collected before fields exist
callers.hazard: Native resource exists while Scheme wrapper does not; partially initialized body may not be exposed to scanner
callers.replacement: Preinstalled ResultSlot/RootView; bounded initialized-body publication with no implicit safepoint; source proof open

callers.actualChain: accept socket; setup client; close socket on setup failure; TLS SSL_new/SSL_accept; transfer close responsibility
callers.hazard: Server borrower, accepted socket, client storage and TLS state are distinct; callbacks/configuration unqualified
callers.replacement: Client escrow identity plus server lease and staged socket/TLS custody; do not re-accept on lost result

callers.actualChain: C wrapper conversion fails then cleanup(d server); Scheme read holds port mutex, retries EINTR, releases lock for EAGAIN, raises other errors
callers.hazard: Wrong rollback target and owner-held port mutex; generic replay can consume a different connection
callers.replacement: Rollback only captured client; scanner never takes port mutex; preserve Scheme error/return boundary

callers.actualChain: Mask interrupts; create pipes/fork; read exec status; setup device and transfer close responsibility; unmask; Windows has distinct handles
callers.hazard: Live child may exist before setup/result publication; native pipe/dev failure not inverse of fork/exec
callers.replacement: Separate child identity/status duty, device/fd stages, string temporaries and source-visible result; no generic kill or refork

callers.actualChain: String-list conversions; native process setup; wrapper failure lacks local device cleanup, then string temporaries released; Scheme expects fixnum or device
callers.hazard: Failure path can return result #f from converter while dev duty persists; generated function counts do not close ownership
callers.replacement: Typed return slot commits original error e and retains dev/child escrow; audit semantics/correction before admission

callers.actualChain: Device records pid/status/cleanuped; POSIX status updated asynchronously; close polls status; Win32 closes process/thread handles
callers.hazard: Closing pipes/handles/device storage does not prove child exit or termination; signal/group reader may still use it
callers.replacement: Separate native process/status borrower pins and acknowledged close disposition; teardown waits exact readers, not inferred process death

callers.actualChain: Allocate/register RC MSG; PeekMessage(PM_REMOVE) may dispatch sent messages and then consume queued message; direct conversion return
callers.hazard: Thread-affine reentry, consumed message, arbitrary pointer payload and RC owner lifetime
callers.replacement: Reserve before read; known MSG escrow before wrapper allocation; suspended-callback view only with complete parent/callback roots

callers.actualChain: Outer C propagates error; Scheme event read holds mutex and retries EINTR/EAGAIN or raises; wrapper success drops still hold
callers.hazard: Conversion failure after PM_REMOVE cannot be rolled back by re-reading; RC data field starts FAL but does not root arbitrary MSG pointers
callers.replacement: Keep original consumed message/RC duty; no requeue/replay equivalence claim; preserve thread dispatch and exception boundary

callers.actualChain: Group links, refcount, close responsibility; cleanup unlinks, may wait and device_release can free despite error
callers.hazard: Group membership/refcount is not independent collector lifetime/atomic ownership; owner callback can need resume permit
callers.replacement: Dedicated native lease/custody and WaitContext; typed physical disposition; drain before group/RC/OS withdrawal

callers.actualChain: FOREIGN payload opaque; sweep releases before free; cleanup_rc unconditionally frees chain before OS cleanup
callers.hazard: Escrow raw native pointers are not managed root handles; addref does not survive processor teardown
callers.replacement: Canonical root-domain registration/scan and physical RC transfer/drain; imported proof obligations stay open

callers.actualChain: Generated conversion templates and scheme-object C stubs expose result/error boundaries
callers.hazard: Moving native work to generic worker may change c-lambda, callback, exception and held-lock semantics
callers.replacement: Scheme keeps semantic/FrameSpec contract; modern C consumes typed constructor/root/result specs with origin-specific adapters
